sloka: ह्रीमन्तः कीर्तिमन्तः च सर्वज्ञा दीर्घ दर्शिनः ।तेषाम् एवम् प्रभावाणाम् सर्वेषाम् दीप्त तेजसाम् ॥१-१८-३५॥
transliteration: hrīmantaḥ kīrtimantaḥ ca sarvajñā dīrgha darśinaḥ ।teṣām evam prabhāvāṇām sarveṣām dīpta tejasām ॥1-18-35॥

translations.english: They (like) tigers among men, were fond of the study of the Vedas and were always engaged in the service of their parents. They were also proficient in the science of archery.
